name: Stack-Based Representation (SBR)
definition: Decomposition of a voxel grid V (resolution w × h × d) into a set S of vertical stacks, where each stack Sx,y represents the column of voxels at position xy.
summary: Stack-Based Representation is a sparse volumetric structure that compresses vertical voxel columns into run-length encoded intervals, optimizing specifically for layered data with strong vertical coherence.
